summary: Co-locate each Storybook file's reviewed scenario exemptions with its stories and drop the central exemption registry and its exact-count pin, so parallel story PRs no longer conflict on one shared list.

replay.detail: No replay change; only the development story check and story file metadata change.

compatibility.detail: Development-only. The story check still requires the collected exemptions to equal the reviewed ids exactly, now as the union of per-file scenarioExemptions exports (the same reviewed ids, now co-located with their stories), and rejects stale, duplicate or unsorted ids and lists not excluded from Storybook stories.

manual.detail: Open PRs that add exemptions move their ids once from scenario-exemption-ids.ts into their stories file's scenarioExemptions export.
